new_roles.description:
**Position Summary...**
-----------------------

Role summary: The (USA) Director, Operations leads the execution of complex projects and programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives through strategic planning, data analysis, and cross-functional collaboration. This role directs operational initiatives to enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and drive business growth while managing budgets and performance standards. The Director fosters strong partnerships across teams to implement innovative solutions and continuous improvements. By leveraging analytical insights and operational expertise, this position supports decision-making processes and promotes a culture of accountability, integrity, and excellence to achieve sustainable organizational success. About the team: The team drives the transformation of Walmart’s fulfillment capabilities to enhance the customer experience through strategic program management and data-driven decision-making. It leads initiatives across speed, assortment, pricing, and recovery by collaborating with Product, Pricing, Walmart+, Merchandising, Network, Operations, Analytics, and Finance teams. Focused on identifying challenges, designing tests, and scaling solutions, the team ensures alignment with Walmart’s goals through effective stakeholder engagement, financial oversight, and business operations. This collaborative environment emphasizes innovation and operational excellence to deliver impactful, scalable results.

**What you'll do...**
---------------------

**What you'll do:**
 

* Oversee execution of complex projects and programs, managing timelines, budgets, and performance standards to ensure successful implementation.
* Analyze data and business trends to develop actionable recommendations aligned with organizational objectives.
* Lead cross-functional teams to design and implement process improvements that enhance operational efficiency and reduce costs.
* Build and maintain strategic partnerships with key stakeholders to support business initiatives and drive execution.
* Develop and monitor scorecards and tracking mechanisms to measure outcomes and adjust strategies accordingly.
* Foster talent development through coaching, mentoring, and succession planning to maintain a skilled workforce.
* Promote adherence to company standards of integrity, ethics, and compliance across teams.

 
**What you'll bring:**
 

* Extensive experience in operations management and leading large-scale complex projects with proven ability to manage timelines, budgets, and performance metrics.
* Strong proficiency in business strategy development, data analysis, and translating insights into actionable recommendations aligned with organizational goals.
* Demonstrated success in cross-functional team leadership, fostering collaboration to drive process improvements and operational efficiency.
* Expertise in developing and implementing innovative solutions to reduce costs and enhance business outcomes.
* Proven capability in talent development, mentoring, and succession planning to build and sustain high-performing teams.
* Commitment to integrity, ethical leadership, and promoting a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more. You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable. For information about PTO, see https://one.walmart.com/notices. Live Better U is a Walmart-paid education benefit program for full-time and part-time associates in Walmart and Sam's Club facilities. Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.

**DEPT OF TRANSPORTATION**
==========================

***Be a part of an innovative and collaborative team driving a safer transportation system for Arizona.***
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **MVD Deputy Division Director of Operations**

Job Location:

#### **Address: Motor Vehicle Division** **1801 W. Jefferson St.** **Phoenix, AZ 85007**

Posting Details:

#### **Salary Range: $155,000 - $165,000**

#### **Anticipated Salary: $160,000**

#### **Grade: 32**

#### **Closing Date: 11/12/2026**

Job Summary:

Works closely with the Division Director as a senior member of Division leadership, overseeing operations and developing, sponsoring and overseeing operational improvements. Directs implementation of effective controls to ensure integrity of Division work flow, processes, and products. Reviews operational progress toward completion of initiatives to meet strategic targets and redirects efforts and resources as needed. Collaborates with the rest of MVD leadership to refine and implement MVD’s strategic plan. Collaborates with internal and external partners, stakeholders and customers to direct the design and implementation of improvements and solutions to various issues. Supports process improvement initiatives and serves as an executive sponsor of process improvement projects. Travel may be required, including overnight stays.

This position may offer the ability to work remotely, within Arizona, based upon the department's business needs and continual meeting of expected performance measures.

The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that affords employees flexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, and commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in offices, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona unless an exception is properly authorized in advance.

Job Duties:

Operational oversight: Oversees daily administrative operations, including managing risk, budget, delivery of results and overall agency operational performance.
 
 
Process optimization: Streamline internal systems, eliminate waste, introduce performance metrics (KPIs), and continuously improve operational efficiency and cost-effectiveness
 
 
Strategy and Vision: Works closely with the Division Director to develop and translate vision and strategies into division operations. Travel may be required, including overnight stays.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs):

Knowledge of:
 

* Training and employee development best practices
* Federal and state legislative process
* Audit and program compliance
* Personnel management
* Lean or other recognized process improvement
* AI concepts, tools and methodologies
* Political processes

 
Skill in:
 

* Operational management and political acumen
* Communicating effectively and concisely, both orally and in writing
* Presenting clearly articulated data, anticipating leadership questions
* Leadership and communication, including influencing and negotiating
* Building consensus among internal and external stakeholders
* Developing and implementing metrics and measurement systems
* Statistical analysis

 
Ability to:
 

* Lead, manage, and monitor programs
* Implement and lead change initiatives
* Work in highly variable assignments
* Analyze information and data, and prepare reports
* Identify and draw on analytical tools and techniques to develop creative approaches and new insights to business issues
* Conduct research; using gathered data, develop recommendations for improvement
* Assess current and future staffing needs based on organizational goals and budget constraints
* Recommend and implement effective business and process controls
* Collaborate and build business relationships

Selective Preference(s):

Extensive experience in change management, planning, management of large scale organization operations.

Pre-Employment Requirements:

This position requires driving or the use of a vehicle as an essential function of the job, and the following requirements apply. Any employee operating a motor vehicle on State business must possess and retain a current, valid class-appropriate driver’s license, complete all required training, and successfully pass all necessary driver’s license record checks. The license must be current, unexpired, and neither revoked nor suspended. Employees who drive on state business are subject to driver’s license record checks, must maintain acceptable driving records, and must complete all required driver training. An employee who operates a personally owned vehicle on state business shall maintain the statutorily required liability insurance (see Arizona Administrative Code (A.A.C.) R2-10-207.11).

All newly hired State employees are subject to and must successfully complete the Electronic Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E-Verify).

Benefits:

The Arizona Department of Administration offers a comprehensive benefits package to include:
 

* Sick leave
* Vacation with 10 paid holidays per year
* Paid Parental Leave-Up to 12 weeks per year paid leave for newborn or newly-placed foster/adopted child (pilot program).
* Health and dental insurance
* Retirement plan
* Life insurance and long-term disability insurance
* Optional employee benefits include short-term disability insurance, deferred compensation plans, and supplemental life insurance

By providing the option of a full-time or part-time remote work schedule, employees enjoy improved work/life balance, report higher job satisfaction, and are more productive. Remote work is a management option and not an employee entitlement or right. An agency may terminate a remote work agreement at its discretion.

Learn more about the Paid Parental Leave program here. For a complete list of benefits provided by The State of Arizona, please visit our benefits page

Retirement:

Mandatory participation in the Arizona Retirement System (ASRS) is required.

Contact Us:

For questions about this career opportunity, please contact ADOT Human Resources Recruitment via email at srecruitment@azdot.gov or phone call at (602) 712-8186 option 2.

The State of Arizona is an Equal Opportunity/Reasonable Accommodation Employer. Persons with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation such as a sign language interpreter or an alternative format by calling (602) 712-8186 option 3. new_roles.title: Director, Merchandising Operations
new_roles.description:
Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment.

Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

### **About the Role**

Parachute Health is building the definitive platform for ordering home medical equipment and supplies, helping clinicians and suppliers ensure that millions of patients each year receive the critical equipment and supplies they need. Our Merchandising Operations team (AKA "Merch") comprises Category Managers and Category Analysts who have three primary jobs: 1) build and maintain our catalog, 2) build and maintain our coverage criteria rules engine, and 3) partner with R&D to improve the tools and workflows behind both. Merch sits at the intersection of e-commerce, compliance, operations, and R&D, and its work is central to Parachute's core functionality. Clinicians use our catalog to find and order the right equipment for their patients, and suppliers rely on it to fulfill those orders. Our coverage criteria help users determine whether an item should be covered by the patient's insurance.

The Merch team's work is nuanced and detail-dense: we maintain information on tens of thousands of products so our software, and the people who use it, can rely on it. The 18-person team splits its time between project work, like building and redesigning product categories and turning payer rules into qualification questions, and ticket-based work, resolving complex requests escalated by our support and partner teams. Our work requires efficient operational processes and excellent documentation.

As Director of Merchandising Operations, you will own the team's operating framework: how work is planned, prioritized, and delivered, and how the team partners with other teams across Parachute. You'll coach and develop a mix of managers and individual contributors, lead the team's largest cross-functional projects, and serve as a close thought partner to the SVP of Merchandising.

The role is primarily internal (roughly 90%), with occasional customer communication, especially on escalations, that calls for a steady, polished hand.

### **What You'll Do**

* Be the operational leader for a highly motivated, highly capable team of managers and individual contributors: keep work running smoothly, protect morale, and learn and add to a team culture that is already strong.
* Drive key projects: stay close to the work and personally drive the team's largest, most complex projects, including timelines, dependencies, and cross-team communication.
* Know every team process end to end. Lead the creation, maintenance, and centralization of SOPs and shared resources; drive consistent practices, training, quality assurance, and continuous improvement across category teams.
* Collaborate with partner teams (e.g., Supplier Implementation, Product, Customer Success) so handoffs and shared processes run smoothly.
* Be a Merch advocate: make the team's work understandable and visible across the company.
* Run bandwidth and capacity planning; flag risks early and rebalance coverage.
* Define and report on team metrics (ticket throughput, SLAs, SKU work, rollout milestones).
* Own escalations as needed, partnering effectively with people at all levels across the organization.
* Support recruiting as needed, own onboarding for new merchants, and maintain continuity coverage for every category.

### **Requirements**

* 7+ years in operations, program delivery, or management or technology consulting (e.g., a Big Four or top-tier firm), with 3+ years managing and growing managers.
* Track record of delivering complex, cross-functional projects using a clear, repeatable methodology.
* Data-driven: comfortable with capacity models, dashboards and prioritization trade-offs.
* Willingness to travel roughly once a quarter.

### **More About You**

* Passionate about improving patient outcomes in the healthcare space.
* Gets things done: drives work to completion and builds processes that stick.
* Thrives in complex, nuanced domains; quickly learns intricate systems (e.g., insurance coverage rules, product data) well enough to make sound calls.
* Clear, concise communicator who pushes back constructively and drives decisions.
* Sound compliance judgment: in a highly regulated industry, you know which issues to resolve and which to escalate.
* Track record of growing into increasing scope and responsibility.
* Nice to have: catalog, product data or e-commerce experience; healthcare, DME/HME or payer experience.

### **Benefits**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage: Comprehensive plans with options for low-to-no-cost premiums
* Employer HSA Contribution: Company-funded contributions to your Health Savings Account
* 401(k) Retirement Plan
* Equity Incentive Plan
* Annual Company-Wide Bonus: Opportunity for up to 15% bonus based on company performance
* Remote-First Culture: We are remote-first with a dedicated NYC office and reimbursement options for co-working spaces
* Flexible Vacation Policy
* Summer Fridays: 5 additional Fridays off during the summer (separate from PTO)
* Home Office and Wellness Stipend
* Monthly Internet Stipend
* Annual Learning and Development Stipend

### **Base Salary Range (based on level and experience)**

$145,000-$180,000

JOB ID: R-259392 LOCATION: United States - Remote WORK LOCATION TYPE: Remote DATE POSTED: Nov. 02, 2026 CATEGORY: Clinical SALARY RANGE: -

**Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients**
--------------------------------------------

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

 
 
 

**Local Study Operations Manager (LSOM), Director**
---------------------------------------------------

**What you will do**
--------------------

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will provide strategic and operational leadership for the country LSOM organization and is accountable for the quality, timeliness, cost, and compliant execution of the country clinical study portfolio. The role achieves results through LSOM Senior Managers and their FTE and FSP teams, translating global clinical development strategy into country operating priorities. The role directs portfolio delivery, resource and capacity strategy, financial planning, quality and risk management, vendor performance, and inspection readiness from feasibility through study close-out. As a member of the country leadership team, this role influences study placement and portfolio decisions, leads the resolution of significant operational issues, develops organizational capability and succession plans, and represents LSOM operations in country, regional, and global governance forums.

 
 

**Accountabilities**

* Lead the successful delivery of the country study portfolio through the LSOM management organization, ensuring alignment with global clinical development priorities.

* Provides strategic direction and leadership to LSOM country organization across the full study lifecycle, including feasibility, study execution, and study close-out.

* Establishes portfolio-level oversight of delivery, quality, risk, timelines, and performance, directing timely escalation and resolution of critical issues for LSOM management organization.

* Manage LSOM and LSOM vendor performance to guarantee high-quality study execution, serving as the primary escalation point for local study challenges, driving solutions, and ensuring portfolio targets are met within the country.

* Build leadership capability within the LSOM organization through targeted coaching, development, and succession planning, preparing LSOMs to lead increasingly complex trials and programs.

* Establishes strong operating partnerships with Clinical Research Associate (CRA) organization to support study start-up, monitoring, issue resolution, and compliant trial execution across the country portfolio.

* Cultivate a high-performing, accountable, and inclusive organization focused on operational excellence and continuous improvement.

* Champion strong integration between study strategy and local execution teams to translate portfolio priorities into effective country-level delivery.

* Strengthen cross-functional alignment and accountability across country teams to accelerate execution and deliver portfolio commitments.

* Influences study-placement and portfolio investment decisions by providing strategic insight into country's capabilities, operational readiness, performance, and growth potential.

* Anticipates portfolio-level delivery risks, quality trends, and evolving resource requirements, directing mitigation strategies and systemic improvements across country operations.

* Sponsor initiatives that advance operational efficiency, digital innovation, organizational capability, and the adoption of leading practices.

* Direct resource strategy, capacity planning, and workload allocation across FSP and FTE LSOM teams to optimize execution and align resources with global priorities.

* Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, GCP, ICH, and organizational standards across the country's study portfolio.

Partner with the Regional Head/Country Head and senior cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities, establish accountability for trial deliverables, and resolve significant escalations. 



**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the functional leader for LSOM Senior Managers and the broader LSOM team, including both FSP and FTE, to optimize trial execution and align with global priorities. including strategy and execution, managing risks and escalations

* Partners closely with CRAs, CSPO, Quality, and FSP partners.

* Leads the coordination among country functional teams to ensure successful delivery of the country portfolio.

* Ensure inspection readiness and provide hands-on support during inspections, including responsibility for storyboards.

* Sponsors continuous operational improvement initiatives and encourage sharing of best practices.

* Ensure compliance with relevant regulatory and quality standards.

* Collaborate with the Regional Head/Country Head to engage cross-functional stakeholders, align on trial deliverables, and manage escalations as needed.

**Capability Building and People Leadership**

* Lead, coach, and develop LSOM Sr Managers, including performance management, succession planning, and leadership bench development.

* Build the organizational capabilities, resourcing needed to meet the current and future regional portfolio requirements.

* Foster a high-performing, inclusive, accountable, and patient-focused culture across geographically distributed teams.

* Lead organizational changes and enable adoption of new operating models, technologies

**Authority**

* Accountable for country level oversight and delivery of clinical trials.

* Manage the performance of LSOM Senior Managers and their teams

* Holds line management authority for regional and country operations leaders, including performance management, talent development, succession planning, and capability building.

* Sets regional delivery goals, operating expectations, and performance standards across study start-up, site engagement, monitoring, execution, and closeout.

* Capability build, talent and performance management, and acting as a liaison for cultural differences within region.

**Outputs**

* Manage LSOM resources in accordance with the global study strategy.

* Oversee resource allocation and workload balance across LSOMs.

* Handle FSP supplier resource coordination and monitor performance through quality oversight metrics.

* Identify and report any risks or compliance concerns related to FSP activities.

* Escalate issues to the Regional/Country Head as necessary.

**What we expect of you**

 
 

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Doctorate degree and 4 years of clinical research experience OR
* Master’s degree and 7 years of clinical research experience OR
* Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of clinical research experience

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 4 years of direct managerial and/or leadership experience or equivalent

* Deep knowledge of ICH GCP, ICH E6(R3), ICH E8(R1), and global regulatory expectations for risk-based monitoring and clinical trial oversight.

* Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead complex cross-functional initiatives within a global matrix organization

* Strong Project Management experience

* Experience managing multiple teams / direct reports across multiple clinical functions / trials

* Experience at, or oversight of, clinical research vendors (CROs, central labs, imaging vendors, etc.)

* Experience managing clinical operations across relevant geography / region, including strong understanding of local regulatory requirements around global clinical trials

**What you can expect of us**
-----------------------------

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is posted. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.

Base Salary Range: $195,876-265,008

 
 

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:

* A comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts
* A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
* Stock-based long-term incentives
* Award-winning time-off plans
* Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Description Director of Operations - Hybrid

**Role Overview:**

We are seeking a high-caliber, transformative **Director of Operations** to lead, scale, and optimize our operations. In this role, you will serve as a strategic leader responsible for driving operational excellence, customer advocacy, and regulatory integrity across a multi-faceted organization.

 
 

You will move beyond routine contact center management to steer a dynamic organization comprised of specialized internal operational teams—covering strategic readiness, advanced customer advocacy, and complex fraud/escalation management—alongside large-scale BPO vendor partners managing ~200+ frontline agents.

 
 

You bring a blend of strategic vision, process optimization discipline, vendor governance, and high-impact people leadership required to elevate operational standards and deliver best-in-class customer experiences.

 
 

**You have a proven track record of:**

* **Large-Scale Operations Leadership**: Successfully leading multi-site contact center operations combining internal teams and offshore/nearshore vendor partners of 200+ headcount.
* **Operational Transformation**: Transforming reactive service centers into proactive, quality-focused customer advocacy hubs through structured process engineering.
* **Escalation & Fraud Management**: Effectively mitigating enterprise risk through robust Tier 2 & 3 complaint handling, fraud prevention protocols, and regulatory adherence.
* **Vendor Operations Governance**: Driving rigorous SLA performance, cost efficiency, and quality alignment across third-party BPO vendor organizations.
 

 

**What you’ll do:**

The Director of Operations maintains end-to-end accountability for operational strategy, performance delivery, vendor oversight, and organizational readiness.

* **Leadership Reach**: Direct oversight of Department Managers, Unit Managers (UMs), and Vendor Managers (VMs) across internal and external business units.
* **Core Internal Operations**:
 + **Strategic Operations:** Driving CX quality call listening, 1:1 and group coaching/training, operations readiness, and training materials maintenance.
 + **Customer Advocacy:** Overseeing high-touch inbound customer service, task execution, complex account resolution, and U.S. transfer handling.
 + **Escalations and Fraud**: Leading high-severity escalated problem solving, fraud operations, customer complaint research and resolution, and escalation follow-ups.
* **Core External Operations:**
 + Governance and SLA performance tracking for primary vendor partners overseeing a network of ~200+ non-associate vendor agents performing inbound calls and funding workflows.

 

**Key Focus Areas:**

* Reimagine end to end Operations in this era of AI
* Strategic Leadership & Governance to formulate and execute long-term operational strategies and partner cross functionally
* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Business Analysis, and Process teams to establish and update processes, policies, procedures, and standards
* Define operational KPIs, quality targets, and SLA metrics to ensure consistent service delivery, funding accuracy, and customer satisfaction
* Direct vendor management leads to oversee third-party partners, ensuring ~200+ vendor agents adhere to operational guidelines and productivity benchmarks
* Risk, Fraud, & Complaint Resolution spanning complex problem solving and root-cause analysis
* Ensure business readiness for product launches, process updates, and technology enhancements across all operational sub-functions
* Mentor, develop, and inspire a multi-layered leadership team, cultivating a culture of accountability, continuous learning, and high performance.
* Optimize talent allocation and capacity planning across teams to handle volume fluctuations dynamically.
 

 

**Location:** Plano, TX - This role is designated as a hybrid position. You are expected to adhere to Capital One's hybrid policy regarding required on-site presence at your designated office location.

 
 

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or military experience
* At least 5 years of people leadership experience
* At least 5 years of process or project management experience
* At least 5 years of relationship management experience
* At least 5 years of experience delivering transformational initiatives
 

 

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* PMP, Lean, Agile, or Six Sigma certification
* At least 3 years of operations people leadership experience
* At least 7 years of people leadership experience

This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan.

new_roles.title: Field Operations Director
new_roles.description:
### **The Position**

From the beginning, Genentech has been a team of highly dedicated, passionate individuals. We are a place where people are united around a single purpose and an ambitious vision. Together, we aspire to deliver ever better health outcomes for patients while lowering overall healthcare costs. Our goal is to compel the customer to act on behalf of their patients while showing great commitment to the rare disease community, whose support is key. Utilizing innovative methods to identify patients who may benefit from treatment, we must take a highly strategic approach to patient access while assisting patients and their caregivers to navigate the healthcare system.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Field Operations Director serves as the trusted operations partner to an assigned Regional VP or National Team VP and their leadership team, helping translate business priorities into clear plans, coordinated execution, and effective connection to the broader CE Operations and enterprise support network. The Director owns the operating rhythm and priority agenda for the assigned leadership team and provides a single point of connectivity between Field Leadership and the broader operational ecosystem.

SCOPE & KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategic Partnership with Field Leadership

* Serve as the primary Operations partner to an assigned Regional VP or National Team VP and their leadership team.
* Develop a deep understanding of the team's business priorities, customers, opportunities, challenges, and performance.
* Translate enterprise and CE priorities into clear implications and action plans for the assigned Region or National Team.
* Provide strategic and operational counsel to leadership and proactively identify issues requiring attention, decisions, or escalation.
* Help leadership prioritize competing needs and maintain focus on the highest-impact business opportunities.

Operating Rhythm & Business Planning

* Own the operating rhythm and priority agenda for the assigned leadership team.
* Lead development and coordination of annual, quarterly, and other operating plans.
* Translate priorities into clear roadmaps with owners, milestones, dependencies, and measures of progress.
* Coordinate leadership agendas, decision materials, action tracking, and follow-through.
* Support Regional or National Team input into ABP, resource planning, RBO, and other CE and enterprise planning processes.

Operational Integration & Execution

* Serve as a front door for operational requests from the assigned leadership team and route needs to the appropriate CE Operations or enterprise partner.
* Connect Field Leadership and HEDs to the broader support network without requiring them to independently navigate multiple teams.
* Coordinate across Enterprise Operations, RBO, Squad Field Partners, ABP, DDA, L&SD, and other functions to enable execution.
* Anticipate execution barriers, dependencies, and operational risks and mobilize partners to resolve them.
* Ensure appropriate communication and coordination between enterprise initiatives and Regional/National execution.

Insights & Decision Support

* Synthesize field insights, performance signals, customer information, and emerging business needs into clear leadership implications.
* Develop business reviews and decision materials that enable productive leadership conversations.
* Identify patterns and recurring needs that may have implications beyond the assigned Region or National Team.
* Surface cross-field opportunities, risks, and common needs to the Head of CE Field Operations so they can be addressed across the organization where appropriate.
* Provide recommendations related to priorities, resources, capacity, and operational tradeoffs.

Resource & Capacity Planning

* Maintain an integrated understanding of the assigned team's resource and capacity requirements.
* Support Regional or National Team roster, resource, and capacity planning.
* Identify capacity constraints and emerging needs and develop recommendations in partnership with Field Leadership.
* Connect local resource needs to broader CE and enterprise planning processes.

KEY DELIVERABLES

* Annual and quarterly operating plans
* Regional or National Team priority roadmap
* Leadership agendas, decision materials, and action logs
* Business reviews and synthesized field insights
* RBO, ABP, and enterprise planning inputs
* Resource, roster, and capacity plans
* Consolidated requests, risks, and capacity recommendations
* Clear escalation of cross-field opportunities and common operational needs

MINDSET & CAPABILITIES

* Trusted partner who builds credibility with senior Field Leaders
* Strategic thinker with strong operational discipline
* Able to translate ambiguity and complexity into clear plans and actions
* Strong business acumen and understanding of field execution
* Highly effective at influencing without formal authority
* Skilled at connecting people, priorities, and resources across organizational boundaries
* Strong analytical and synthesis capabilities
* Proactive and anticipatory rather than reactive
* Comfortable navigating a complex, matrixed environment
* Strong judgment and ability to distinguish between issues that should be solved locally and those requiring enterprise solutions
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining focus on business impact
* Growth mindset and commitment to continuous improvement

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Bachelor's degree required
* Significant pharmaceutical, biotechnology, consulting, commercial, field operations, strategic, and/or analytical experience (8+ years preferred)
* Demonstrated experience partnering with senior business or field leaders
* Experience translating strategy into operational plans and driving execution
* Strong project/program management and cross-functional leadership capabilities
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively within a complex matrixed organization
* Strong communication, executive presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Ability and willingness to travel as required for internal and external business meetings

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

* Graduate-level degree (e.g., MBA or advanced life sciences degree)
* Prior Field, Field Operations, Commercial Operations, or business planning experience
* Experience with resource planning, business planning, account planning, or field effectiveness
* Experience supporting Regional or National field leadership teams

new_roles.description:
**Job Description**

**This role is fully remote and must be located within the 50 U.S. states. Standard working hours are in Eastern Timezone. Semi-annual travel may be required to a Devoted office for on-site work.**

**A bit about this role:**

At Devoted, our mission is to dramatically improve the health and well-being of our members by treating each of them like family. Devoted is growing at an incredible pace, and we are thrilled to welcome and serve every new member who joins us. This growth demands that our Utilization Management (UM) operation must scale and evolve without ever losing sight of the people at the center of every authorization.

We believe UM done right means decisions that are correct, fair, and fast, delivered through a frictionless process and with heart. Behind every request is a member waiting on care and a provider working to deliver it. UM is hard, but the challenge doesn’t exempt us from our mission.

We are seeking a curious, operationally minded leader to serve as Director, Utilization Management Operations. Reporting to the Vice President of Health Services, you will lead the teams behind our administrative work: a large onshore and offshore team of UM Administrative Coordinators who manage intake, outreach, notifications, and follow-up. You will also hold dotted-line accountability for monitoring and ensuring the success of our Part B medical authorization turnaround times (TAT).

This role is for someone who is energized by a complex process: someone who wants to unravel it, reimagine it, and lead the build of something simpler, faster, and more consistent. You will have significant influence over the roadmap for Orinoco, our internal technology platform, and an integrated AI engine to put to work. This role will help pave the way towards realizing the next generation of our UM program, driving improvements in effectiveness, efficiency, and experience for our members and provider partners.

**Your Responsibilities and Impact will include**:

* **SLA & Timeliness Ownership:** Own SLA performance for the administrative steps that support authorization review across UM, delivering consistent, predictable performance at a meaningfully lower cost. Hold dotted-line accountability for Part B medical authorization turnaround times (TAT), partnering with the clinical leaders of that team to monitor performance, surface risks early, and remove administrative barriers to on-time decisions.
* **Process Reimagination:** Map our administrative processes end to end, including auth intake, requests for additional clinical information, facility census checks, member and provider notifications, and member follow-up, and lead their redesign for speed, consistency, and simplicity.
* **Technology & AI Leadership:** Partner with Product and Engineering to shape the Orinoco roadmap so that process and technology evolve together. Put our integrated AI tools to work to remove manual effort, so our administrative capacity no longer has to grow at the same rate as our membership.
* **Build for Measurement:** Design processes that are highly measurable and transparent by default. Partner with Data Science to define and monitor the KPIs that matter, including timeliness, cost per authorization, quality, and provider experience, and use them to drive decisions and continuous improvement.
* **People & Vendor Leadership:** Lead and develop a team that includes approximately 50 onshore UM Administrative Coordinators and their leaders. Manage our offshore vendor partnership, which supports more than 250 administrative team members, holding it to clear performance standards while building a shared culture of ownership and care.
* **Provider & Member Experience:** Partner with the Provider Network team to understand what providers and facilities need from this process, and build it in. Design every touchpoint, from outreach to notifications to follow-up, with the humans on the other end in mind.
* **Cross-Functional Partnership:** Work closely with the Senior Director of UM, who owns end-to-end authorization performance, along with the UM Medical Directors, Compliance, Provider Network, Data Science, and Engineering teams to keep the operation aligned and consistently audit-ready.

**Required skills and experience:**

* **Mission & Heart:** A genuine commitment to treating members like family, and a belief that operational excellence and empathy belong together.
* **Proven Operator at Scale:** A track record of leading high-volume operations that deliver consistent SLA performance.
* **Builder Mindset:** Experience taking a complex, multi-step process apart and leading the build of a simpler, more scalable one, rather than only maintaining what exists. You are naturally curious and ask why a step exists before deciding how to improve it.
* **Metrics-Oriented:** You build for measurement, are comfortable working deep in the workflows and the data, and use both to drive decisions and hold teams and partners accountable.
* **Technology & AI Curiosity:** Experience partnering with product and engineering teams, and genuine excitement about using AI-enabled tools to transform how work gets done.
* **Vendor Management:** Experience managing vendor partners against clear performance and quality standards.
* **Communication:** Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex problems into actionable updates for leadership and stakeholders.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree required.

**Desired skills and experience**:

* **Healthcare Operations:** Experience in payer operations, utilization management, claims, provider revenue cycle, or a similar high-volume healthcare environment. Prior UM experience is not required.
* **Medicare Advantage Familiarity:** Understanding of Medicare Advantage operations and CMS requirements.
* **Advanced Degree:** MBA or advanced degree in health administration or finance is a plus.
* MBA or advanced degree in health administration or finance is a plus.

Step into a leadership role, where your management skills will drive strategic risk and compliance initiatives. Embrace the opportunity to enhance your leadership capabilities and make a meaningful impact on the future of risk management and control testing. 
 
As a **Compliance and Operations Risk Test Director** in the Testing Center of Excellence, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the testing strategy across various business lines, ensuring alignment with regulatory and firm requirements. Your expertise in risk management and control testing will be instrumental in identifying and mitigating risks, thereby enhancing compliance and operational risk management. You will be expected to make independent decisions that significantly impact operations and financial management, while also leading large teams and managing service delivery. Your proficiency in problem-solving, decision-making, and resource optimization will be key in driving results that accelerate our business objectives. Your role will also involve fostering strong relationships with stakeholders, interpreting regulatory requirements, and effectively communicating risk reports to various management levels. 
 
**Job responsibilities**

* Lead the development and implementation of comprehensive testing strategies across various business lines, ensuring alignment with regulatory and firm requirements.
* Oversee complex testing initiatives, utilizing advanced knowledge in risk management and control testing to identify and mitigate unmitigated risks.
* Make independent, strategic decisions that significantly impact operations, financial management, and compliance, based on in-depth analysis and expert judgment.
* Foster strong relationships with senior stakeholders, interpreting regulatory requirements and effectively communicating risk reports to various management levels.
* Manage large teams, setting professional standards, and ensuring efficient service delivery, while also contributing to the longer-term plans for the area to fit within broader functional and organization strategy.

Purpose:

The purpose of the Assistant Director of Operations (ADO) position is to assist the Sr Director Operations in leading and maximizing branch-wide profitability and operations excellence. The ADO ensures branch management staff are prepared to serve our guests with clean restaurants, prepared staff, thorough job knowledge and skills to high performance standards.

Essential Functions:

* Assists the Sr Director Operations in directing the daily operations of the location

* Assists in facilitating the development and implementation of the annual budget, and works with branch-level management to ensure budgeted sales and profit goals are achieved

* Effectively plans, organizes, prioritizes and assigns business activities

* Ensures all company/brand standards and safety guidelines are met

* Resolves most questions and problems and refers only the most complex issues to the SDO

* Ensures managers know and follow opening, daily and closing procedures/checklists in accordance with company policies/procedures

* Interviews job candidates, makes hiring, termination, advancement, promotion or any other status change decisions for associates within the branch. Promotes HMSHost as an employer of choice within the local community

* Actively ensures managers adhere to mandated rest breaks and meal periods

* Ensures compliance with wellness and safety procedures and guidelines, builds awareness about wellness and safety, and reports any safety concerns to the SDO/DO/Zone Leader

* Ensures all managers understand and perform all Health and Safety activities as specified in the Manager’s Guide to Associate Health and Safety

* Reads and understands financial and operational data and reports to monitor progress towards the branch, zone, and restaurant goals and assigns associates to meet those objectives.

* Ensures company and branch diversity and inclusion philosophy is understood and actively executed within the restaurant

* Uses good judgment and broad discretion to resolve customer and associate questions and problems

* Ensures compliance with all company adult beverage policies, and ensures all restaurant staff understand and follow AB procedures

* Ensures display areas are appropriately clean, stocked, and visually appealing

* Ensures all equipment is in good working order

* Ensures that the company has most current contact information for all associates working in the restaurant.

Requirements:

* Ability to work shifts during various operating days and hours each week; during opening, during busy day parts, and during closing to monitor restaurant associates’ and managers’ work activities during these different days and times

* Knowledge of all applicable federal, state, and local sanitary, safety, and health standards, and all procedures and protocols to comply with HACCP standards

Reporting relationship and other important information:

* The ADO position as described falls under the Fair Labor Standards act as a Exempt position

* The ADO position typically reports to the Sr Director of Operations

Minimum Qualifications, Knowledge, Skills, and Work Environment:

* ADOs must have documented and demonstrated skills managing the types of restaurants (QSR, Casual Dine, Full Service, similar complexity, Union and Non-Union, etc) to which the role is assigned, to include overall responsibility for success and failure of the restaurant under their leadership as identified by P&L success for multiple annual cycles for the type or restaurant assigned. Generally speaking, restaurant P&L management experience for a minimum of 5 years with underlying overall working restaurant experience of 8 years in type is typically necessary to be successful.

* Graduation from a Food Service Management or Culinary program may substitute for a portion of the time based experience requirement for each of these roles

* Demonstrates team management, delegation and issue resolution skills and the ability to manage multiple, conflicting, and concurrent priorities

* Demonstrates knowledge of HMSHost policies and products, service, quality, equipment and operations standards, or able to demonstrate this knowledge within a reasonable time from hire or promotion

* Requires the ability to speak, read and comprehend instructions, short correspondence and policy documents, understand menus and brand standards as well as converse comfortably with individuals

new_roles.description:
Sodexo Seniors is seeking a Director of Facilities Operations to support facilities maintenance operations for multiple accounts in the Northeast. Travel will be at 40% and candidate will need to be based in Harrisburg or Lancaster, PA area.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in facilities management, preferably in a healthcare/senior living or regulated environment. Will ensure safe, efficient & well-maintained facilities, delivering exceptional service to client & residents.

**About the job**

In this senior leadership role, you’ll be responsible for overseeing all aspects of facilities operations, from skilled trades and maintenance programs to staffing, safety, and compliance, across complex, high-impact environments. You’ll lead multidisciplinary teams, ensure optimal building performance, and partner with internal stakeholders to drive strategic improvements and operational excellence.

Accountable for managing people, setting direction and deploying resources; typically is responsible for performance evaluation, pay reviews and hire/fire decisions. Results are primarily achieved through the work of others and typically depend on the manager's ability to influence and negotiate with parts of the organization. Progression within Career Band reflects acquisition of broad technical expertise, business and industry knowledge, and process and people leadership capabilities. Accountable for business, functional or operational areas, processes or programs, which may include dotted-line or matrixed management.

**Pay Range:** $115940 per year - $180070 per year

**Incentive Eligibility:** Eligible to participate in Sodexo's incentive plan and earn variable compensation in addition to base salary

**What’s in it for you**

* Lead large-scale facilities operations where your decisions directly impact safety, efficiency, and business continuity.
* Influence strategy and drive innovation by overseeing key infrastructure systems and service delivery.
* Build and lead high-performing teams, fostering a culture of accountability, development, and technical excellence.
* Play a pivotal role in construction planning, system upgrades, and long-term asset preservation.
* Gain visibility and collaboration opportunities with senior stakeholders across a broad operational landscape.
* Manage operational budgets and resources while aligning facilities strategy with organizational goals.
* Thrive in a purpose-driven environment that rewards leadership, problem-solving, and operational precision.

**What you’ll bring**

3+ years of facilities, engineering, or maintenance management experience, preferably in healthcare, senior living, or a related industry. Working knowledge of HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and building systems maintenance.

* Proven experience leading complex facilities operations, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and utility systems.
* Leadership skills with the skillset to manage, mentor, and inspire both frontline teams and management staff.
* Expertise in overseeing construction projects, capital improvements, and long- term infrastructure planning.
* Financial acumen, with experience managing budgets, contracts, and resource allocation.
* Exceptional communication and stakeholder engagement skills to drive alignment and operational success across diverse teams.

**Requirements**

* Education Requirement: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* Management Experience: 5 years
* Related Experience: 5 years

**What we offer**

Compensation is fair and equitable, partially determined by a candidate's education level or years of relevant experience. Salary offers are based on a candidate's specific criteria, like experience, skills, education, and training. Sodexo offers a comprehensive benefits package that may include:

* Medical, Dental, Vision Care and Wellness Programs
* 401(k) Plan with Matching Contributions
* Paid Time Off and Company Holidays
* Career Growth Opportunities and Tuition Reimbursement

More extensive information is provided to new employees upon hire.

**Who we are**

At Sodexo, our purpose is to create a better everyday for everyone and build a better life for all. We believe in improving the quality of life for those we serve and contributing to the economic, social, and environmental progress in the communities where we operate. Sodexo partners with clients to provide a truly memorable experience for both customers and employees alike. We do this by providing food service, catering, facilities management, and other integrated solutions worldwide.

Our company values you for you; you will be treated fairly and with respect, and you can be yourself. You will have your ideas count and your opinions heard because we can be a stronger team when you’re happy at work. This is why we embrace diversity and inclusion as core values, fostering an environment where all employees are valued and respected. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to individuals regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity, pregnancy, disability, sexual orientation, military status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. If you need assistance with the application process, please complete this form.

new_roles.title: Director, Operational Excellence and Innovation
new_roles.description:
**Job Overview**

Citadel Credit Union is seeking a visionary leader to serve as Director of Operational Excellence & Innovation. This role will drive process improvement within the Experience & Retail team and will focus on enhancing current business processes within the team. This position will also focus on integrating new technologies within the organization, such as blockchain (DLT), smart contracts, and artificial intelligence into member and employee experience to drive efficiency, automation and service improvements. The Director will lead, collaborate, and influence the business to modernize workflows, automate processes, and position Citadel as a technology leader in retail financial services.

**What will I be doing?**

As a Director of Operational Excellence & Innovation, you will support Citadel’s Experience and Retail environments in meeting strategic initiatives for our members. The following tasks must be executed with high fidelity:

* Lead the design and implementation of emerging technologies to include blockchain and AI-powered automation solutions for retail operations.
* Act as liaison and collaborate with various lines of business, including EPMO, Digital & Transformation, and Retail Operations & Support.
* Coordinating of testing and implementing branch technology and compliance.
* Act as liaison between the team and internal/external partners to ensure successful deployment of system upgrades and enhancements.
* Manage team related vendor relationships.
* Oversee the development and deployment of smart contracts to automate efficiencies in member onboarding, KYC/AML/NRA compliance, transaction processing, and reporting.
* Identify, assess, and recommend blockchain platforms, smart contract frameworks, and AI vendors to support retail automation initiatives.
* Collaborates on system and workflow enhancements while acting as a vendor and system liaison.
* Manage pilot programs for new automation solutions, collect feedback, refine processes, and oversee full-scale deployment and staff training across team channels.
* Ensure all solutions meet regulatory requirements, maintain data immutability, and enhance fraud prevention through biometric and cryptographic security.
* Monitor system performance, optimize retail workflows, and implement enhancements based on analytics and stakeholder input.
* Develop and execute strategies to overcome resistance to technology adoption, including comprehensive staff training and phased implementation.

**What we are looking for?**

* 7+ years’ experience in process improvement, project management, or technology implementation in retail financial services.
* Bachelor's degree; MBA or advanced degree a plus
* Proven expertise in blockchain/DLT, smart contracts, and AI workflow automation.
* Strong understanding of KYC/AML/NRA compliance and regulatory reporting in retail banking.
* Experience with vendor selection and management for enterprise technology solutions.
* Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to analyze complex retail workflows and drive cross-functional collaboration.
* Familiarity with zero-trust architecture and Microsoft Azure AD integration.
* Experience with RPA tools and business process automation platforms.
* Knowledge of UTAUT, TPB, and TAM models for user technology adoption.
* Prior experience in retail financial technology innovation or credit union operations.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Protected Veterans/Individuals with Disabilities 
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. For further information, please review the Know Your Rights (https://www.eeoc.gov/poster) notice from the Department of Labor.

new_roles.title: Director of Operations
new_roles.description:
Overview:

**Design. Disrupt. Repeat.**

Be an agent of change on a team committed to achieving client-focused, mission-driven excellence. Steampunk is looking for an experienced Director of Operations with an appetite for taking on new challenges.

**Why Steampunk?**

Our people are the very core of what we do; their expertise and hunger for new and exciting challenges fuel our relentless pursuit of mission success. As part of our team of “Punks,” you’ll test the status quo, explore new boundaries, and set the bar high for how government clients expect to engage with contractors.

Contributions:

* Be responsible and accountable for all the operational delivery across the sector
* Provide operational support, leadership, and guidance in the current and future operations of the sector
* Lead a growing team of program, project, and technical leaders in providing best in class IT services
* Identify and hire the absolute best leadership we can find for our client delivery teams
* Support, train, and mentor program and project managers for success in the performance of their work

Qualifications:

* An entrepreneurial desire to build a business
* An informed opinion on what leadership is (and is not)
* A leadership philosophy/methodology
* Experience collaborating with sales, business development, recruiting, contracts, and finance in the pursuit of new contracts/proposals
* Experience collaborating with program managers, project managers, and clients to improve the delivery of services and create “client delight”
* Experience in training and mentorship of project and program managers in the performance of their duties
* Experience being responsible and accountable for the P&L of your area of responsibility
* 10+ years of Program and/or Operations Director/VP experience leading federal IT services work across multiple agencies/components
* Ability to obtain a U.S. government Security Clearance

 
About **steampunk**:

Steampunk relies on several factors to determine salary, including but not limited to geographic location, contractual requirements, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience. The projected compensation range for this position is $180,000 to $250,000. The estimate displayed represents a typical annual salary range for this position. Annual salary is just one aspect of Steampunk’s total compensation package for employees. Learn more about additional Steampunk benefits here.

**Identity Statement**

As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Steampunk is a **Change Agent** in the Federal contracting industry, bringing new thinking to clients in the Homeland, Federal Civilian, Health and DoD sectors. Through our **Human-Centered delivery methodology**, we are fundamentally changing the expectations our Federal clients have for true shared accountability in solving their toughest mission challenges. If you want to learn more about our story, visit http://www.steampunk.com.

*We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Steampunk participates in the E-Verify program.*

We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.

We manage the medical imaging pathway end-to-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.

We're looking for a **Director of Integration & Operational Excellence** at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.

Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.

**WHAT YOU WILL ACHIEVE IN THIS ROLE**
--------------------------------------

You'll report to our Chief Operating Officer and Co-Founder and work closely with the CEO, Corporate Development, our CFO and leaders across Operations, Commercial, Product, Technology, People and Clinical. Your mandate is to make acquisitions work in practice and build the operating capability that allows Scan.com to integrate businesses repeatedly as we grow.

You'll join before upcoming acquisitions close, learn how Scan.com operates, and help prepare both our business and acquired teams for integration. You'll own the integrated plan, budget, dependencies, and delivery cadence from operational diligence through Day 1, the first 100 days, and the handover to business-as-usual owners. Functional leaders retain accountability for decisions in their areas; you'll hold the overall plan together, drive execution, and bring unresolved trade-offs to the COO.

Success means retained customers and referral relationships, uninterrupted patient service, reliable billing and collections, and measurable improvements in operating performance.

* **Lead integration planning before close.** Work with Corporate Development and Finance to test the operating assumptions behind each acquisition, identify integration costs and working-capital needs, and turn diligence findings into a practical delivery plan.
* **Build the integration playbook.** Establish Day 1 readiness criteria, 100-day plans, workstream owners, decision rights, budgets, and escalation routes. Adapt the approach to founder-owned businesses, carve-outs, referral networks and imaging centers.
* **Prepare** **Scan.com** **to receive acquired businesses.** Identify capacity constraints in scheduling, billing, customer support, technology and management. Resolve gaps before moving additional volume onto our platform.
* **Own execution across workstreams.** Lead the integration cadence across Finance, Operations, Commercial, People, Product, Technology and Clinical, working with Legal and Compliance on the approvals needed in their areas. Sequence concurrent integrations around available capacity.
* **Protect the business through change.** Build relationships with acquired founders and teams, identify key people and customer relationships to retain, and coordinate clear communications and responsibilities.
* **Make systems and process changes work operationally.** Partner with technical and operational owners on referral routing, scheduling, imaging systems, reporting and billing migrations. Agree testing, reconciliation, cutover criteria and contingency plans before switching.
* **Deliver the financial case.** Establish baselines with Finance and track revenue retention, collections, operating costs, and realized synergies. Separate one-time integration costs from recurring benefits and avoid counting growth or savings already included in the plan.
* **Improve operating performance across** **Scan.com****.** Lead focused projects on center and mobile-unit economics, staffing, vendor costs, workflows and capacity. Build the business case, implement the changes, and demonstrate the result in operating metrics and the P&L.
* **Build a practical operating cadence.** Maintain a reliable view of owners, milestones, budgets, risks, and decisions. Use automation and AI to reduce reporting work and give leadership concise updates on what needs attention.
* **Make improvements stick.** Document repeatable processes, train the teams who will run them, and hand over completed workstreams with clear ownership and measures of success.

**Example projects**

* Prepare a founder-owned imaging business for Day 1, retaining key relationships while aligning financial reporting and collections.
* Build a carve-out plan that identifies essential staff, systems and shared services, with costed transitional arrangements and clear exit dates.
* Validate referral-level unit economics and center capacity before moving new patient volume onto Scan.com's network.
* Reconcile an acquired company's billing and receivables data, establish collection baselines and resolve issues before a systems migration.

**YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS**
----------------------

Your ramp begins inside Scan.com, before an acquisition closes. The timing of live integrations will depend on the deal pipeline; preparation and operating improvement start immediately.

* **Days 1–30: learn the business at ground level.** Spend time with scheduling, center operations, Commercial, Finance, and revenue-cycle teams. Follow cases from referral through scan, report, billing, and payment. Review prior integrations, map the core systems and handoffs, and establish baseline service and financial metrics.
* **Days 31–60: build readiness.** Assess upcoming acquisitions alongside the deal team. Identify receiving-team capacity constraints, retention risks, and operational dependencies. Produce costed Day 1 and 100-day plans with named owners, and deliver an initial improvement to an existing Scan.com workflow.
* **Days 61–90: test and lead delivery.** Rehearse critical workflows and agree readiness criteria with functional owners. Launch the integration reporting cadence and lead the first implementation workstreams as transactions permit. Give leadership a clear view of what is ready, what needs fixing, and what should be sequenced later.

**How we'll measure success**

* Customer, referral volume, and key-employee retention.
* Patient access, scheduling performance and report turnaround through transitions.
* Billing accuracy, cash collections and receivables performance.
* Realized margin improvement and synergies, validated with Finance and measured against integration costs.
* Delivery against agreed budgets and milestones, followed by a successful handover to operational owners.

**WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE**
-------------------------------------

You don't need to meet every criterion. We are looking for someone who has personally led acquisitions through operational integration and can show what changed after close.

* **A record of delivering integrations.** You've led multiple post-acquisition integrations or substantial workstreams with direct accountability for outcomes. You can explain what went wrong, how you responded, and what the financial and operational results were.
* **Healthcare operating experience.** You've worked in a multisite healthcare, diagnostic imaging, healthcare-services, or similarly complex operating business. Experience in a PE-backed platform, founder-owned acquisition, or carve-out is particularly relevant.
* **Operational and financial depth.** You've owned a P&L, an operating function, or an integration programme with measurable financial responsibility. You can connect staffing, capacity, pricing, service quality, and collections to profitability and cash flow.
* **Understanding of the revenue cycle.** You understand how provider contracts, credentialing, billing workflows, denials, and receivables affect delivery and cash. Imaging-specific experience is valuable.
* **Experience implementing change.** You've worked with technical and operational teams on systems migrations, process standardization, or service transitions, including testing and reconciliation.
* **Credibility with acquired teams.** You can earn the trust of founders and frontline staff, retain what makes a business successful and make difficult changes clearly and respectfully.
* **Strong financial and analytical judgment.** You can build and challenge unit economics, integration budgets and business cases, distinguish recurring benefits from one-off effects, and investigate the detail behind a misleading headline metric.
* **Leadership across functions.** You establish clear accountability, resolve competing priorities and escalate decisions early. You are comfortable holding senior stakeholders to commitments.
* **A hands-on approach.** You're willing to spend time in centers and alongside operating teams, investigate individual cases and improve processes before they are fully documented. The role involves travel to Scan.com operations and acquired businesses.
* **Practical use of AI and automation.** You improve how work gets done while keeping appropriate human review over sensitive data, financial decisions, and operational changes.

Experience in consulting, transaction services, or strategic finance can be valuable when combined with direct responsibility for implementation and results after close.

**AI REQUIREMENTS**
-------------------

At Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. We'll assess this in the way that matters for this role, using the tier below. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to reach for the best tool and get more done as a result.

* Tier 1 — For this role, the expectation is that you are an AI-Native. You build with AI directly, shipping, automating, or prototyping real work with LLMs and agents, and have clear judgment on where humans must stay in the loop.

 + You build with AI, not just alongside it. You've shipped, automated, or prototyped something real using LLMs, agents, or AI tooling.
 + You can explain a workflow you redesigned so a machine does the boring 80%.
 + You have a view on where agentic systems help and where a human must stay in the loop, especially in regulated, PHI-adjacent work.
 + **Assessment:** a practical exercise where you use AI tools live or in a take-home.

**A VIEW ON OUR CULTURE**
-------------------------

We're building something that matters. Every scan we speed up is a real person waiting on an answer, and that urgency runs through everything we do. We move fast, we own outcomes, and take pride in our output. If you like ambiguity, working with ambitious people, and want your work to visibly move the needle, you'll feel at home here.

**HOW WE WILL INTERVIEW YOU**
-----------------------------

We keep our interview process short and sweet. Here are the stages you can expect, but we might switch up the order depending on team availability:

* 30-minute introductory phone call with a member of our Talent Team.
* A 45-minute discussion with the COO covering integrations you've led, the operating decisions you owned, and the results you delivered.
* A practical integration case and 'Scan Standard' interview. You'll assess a fictional acquisition, identify the key risks and build a prioritized Day 1 and 100-day plan. We'll discuss how you would protect service and collections, measure success, and use AI tools in your work.
* Meet the founders and/or other team members. Again, the length varies depending on how many people are involved and whether in person or via video call.
* Offer!

**WHAT WE OFFER**
-----------------

We go beyond the basics with our benefits package. We believe great work starts with supporting our people. Here's what you can expect from us:

* Salary range of **$150,000 - $175,000**
* Equity
* Flexible remote or hybrid work options
* Dedicated personal development budget
* Medical, vision, and dental coverage
* 28+ days of paid time off across PTO and wellbeing days, so you can show up at your best
* Paid parental leave
* 401k retirement plan
* All the equipment you need to do your best work
* Inclusive, people-first policies designed by our team, for our team

**DIVERSITY AT** **SCAN.COM**
-----------------------------

Scan.com is committed to eliminating discrimination and encouraging diversity within our team. We strive to provide equality and fairness for all job applicants and employees and never discriminate on the basis of gender, marital status, age, race, ethnicity, religion, or physical differences.

We are opposed to all forms of unlawful treatment and discrimination.

Our ambition is for our team to be representative of society's diversity, and for every employee to feel respected and able to bring their best selves to work.

If you need an accommodation to apply or interview, contact us at people@scan.com.

We look forward to receiving your application!
